title: Chapter 457
text:
"You — you're not human!"

The person in charge of the research was terrified, and his legs were weak. However, his head was held by Han Xiao, so he could not fall down.

Han Xiao was wearing clothes at this time, and he immediately retracted his Void Form. Only the person in charge of the research who was staring at him clearly saw his change, and the sudden change of appearance made him extremely terrified.

Void creatures were not violent, but their mysterious origin and powerful abilities made most intelligent creatures wary of them.

Han Xiao let go of his hand and let this guy fall to the ground. Han Xiao looked around. The other researchers were all huddled in the corner, not saying a word. These Sunils were just normal people, and Han Xiao had a life level suppression effect on them.

On the side, the few officers did not go up to stop him, turning a blind eye.

"There's no need to hurt him. Black Star, let's go." Herlous was very touched. He did not want to argue, but he did not expect Han Xiao to suddenly speak up for him and even speak his mind.

Indeed, if not for the sake of his race, he could have just stood by and watched. With his Grade B strength, he could live a carefree life in the galaxy. Why would he need to become a mercenary and run around? Those Sunil Supers who had left had this thought in mind.

After going through so many adventures with Han Xiao, he had long seen Han Xiao as a close comrade, a reliable partner, a partner that he could trust with his back. Now that he was contributing to the Black Star Mercenary, it was not just because of Han Xiao's promise. Scenes of fighting side by side flashed through his mind, and Herlous felt warm in his heart.

At dusk, they left the forbidden military area, all the way out of the city, and returned to the spaceship.

This time, Herlous grabbed Han Xiao and laughed heartily. "Haha, actually, I don't really care about what others say. When I was running the bar, I heard this a lot … but thanks anyway."

"It's just scaring people, no big deal. People like you deserve more respect." Han Xiao shrugged.

If he wanted his officers to work for him, he had to pay attention to his image. If he wanted to form the image of a reliable leader, protecting his comrades was the most basic prerequisite. These main characters all had their own ideas. If his actions went against their creed, his backyard would be on fire.

Han Xiao's attitude had always been very neutral. Whether it was obeying the law or committing crimes, he only looked at the benefits and his mood. Obviously, he could gain a good impression just by showing his attitude. Such a good opportunity to win people's hearts, he wouldn't miss it no matter what.

Herlous raised the armor box in his hand and smiled. "Speaking of which, you haven't experienced my combat power in my complete form, right? How about a round?"

"Now? Are you sure? "Han Xiao raised his eyebrows." You want to end this beautiful day with a crushing defeat? "

"You are very arrogant." Herlous was full of confidence. "Shattered Light is a custom-made Commander Class armor that my brother made for me. It can increase my strength by almost half."

Normally, he would often spar with Han Xiao, but most of the time, he would be beaten up. He could only play the role of a practice partner. He had always been depressed, and had long wanted to wash away his shame.

At this moment, he felt that his chance had finally come.

With Han Xiao's strength, it would be very difficult to win against him after he got his armor back.

"Then, I'll try to be gentle. I'll still be the one to fix your armor if I break it."

Han Xiao smiled. He could use this opportunity to reverse engineer the Commander Class armor's blueprint.

Under the setting sun, on the plains.

The two of them were 200 meters apart. This distance was just a sprint for both of them.

Herlous put on Shattered Light, and his face was covered by a helmet. He was covered in silver-blue precision armor, just like a gorgeous ancient knight's armor. Two pieces of pure white soft metal extended out from each of his shoulders, hanging behind him like a cape.

Hum!

A majestic silver-white flame aura soared into the sky, and the dust on the ground rippled. The aura was astonishing. The ten-meter long Battleship Slicing Blade was entwined with a fierce silver wind. The Shattering Light Armor had increased his Pugilist Energy.

The troops in the camp far away sensed this shocking energy wave. The guards came to the edge of the camp and watched in shock.

"He's indeed much stronger." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. Looking at it, Herlous' energy wave in Shattered Light form was at least thirty percent stronger.

Boom!

Herlous swung his blade, and a silver wave of twenty to thirty meters broke through the ground. Dirt flew everywhere like a tsunami. Silver light instantly filled Han Xiao's vision.

Compressed orbs were opened, and the Void Dragon mechanical suit was instantly attached to him. Han Xiao stacked his hands, and gray light surged. Void Spray blasted the incoming wave into pieces.

Swoosh!

The next moment, a cold light flashed past the silver pieces and slashed down. Herlous followed the slash like an arrow. His attacks were swift and fierce, going straight for Han Xiao's face, not giving him any space to set up.

"A tactic that can be guessed without even thinking." Han Xiao dodged to the side easily. The slash hit the ground, and the shockwave spread, turning the ground within dozens of meters into cracked rocks.

He shook his hand, and a black electromagnetic scythe appeared.

"You still have the mood to talk when I'm so close to you?" Herlous snorted. He turned the handle, and the Battleship Slicing Blade shrunk to about one meter long. It was suitable for close-range combat. This thing could be extended and retracted freely.

Dang! Dang!

In the blink of an eye, the scythe and the battle blade clashed more than ten times, and sparks flew everywhere.

The two of them moved around, and the energy from the battle spread everywhere. The ground within a one-mile radius became a mess, and the shockwaves from the battle between Grade B Supers could even destroy a city. The Sunil soldiers watching from afar exclaimed in shock.

Such terrifying individual destructive power dazzled these young soldiers, and they yearned for it.

Herlous' thick energy was like a tidal wave, wave after wave, surging violently. When a Pugilist reached this level, every move they made could cause a huge amount of damage. Their body was their strongest weapon, especially for a Martial Artist like Herlous. When they fought, there was only one word to describe it — ferocious!

Close-Range combat was the strength of the Pugilist class, but Han Xiao was not afraid at all. His various bonuses were not for decoration. When he fought alone, [One Against Ten Thousand Men] alone gave him an eleven percent bonus to all his attributes. When he entered the battle, [Battlefield Wisdom] also started to stack.

"Although I'm not afraid of close-range combat, my strength is also restricted in this situation. Normal restraints can't stop a Pugilist with such destructive power." Han Xiao raised his blade and blocked the slash. At the same time, he activated [Recoil — Thorns] to reflect part of the damage.

Herlous' body shook, and he was pushed back. His legs created a ditch on the ground.

Zeng!

Another compressed orb was activated, and two mechanical wings spread out from his back. A gust of hot wind blew out, and Han Xiao rose into the air. Although he could make anti-gravity devices, he could not make them into independent components of the mechanical suit due to their large size. He had yet to assemble the blueprint of a miniature anti-gravity device.

His flying ability still came from the wings. His power had been strengthened, and supersonic flight was a piece of cake.

Clack!

Floating in midair, Han Xiao opened his arms, and hundreds of compressed orbs shot out from the tubes. They quickly expanded after landing on the ground, turning into cannons and mechanical beasts one after another. It was as though he had scattered beans to form soldiers!

The dense rain of bullets focused on Herlous, who was in the center. The bullets created countless sparks on his armor.

Even though Han Xiao had not had the time to upgrade his machinery and was still using gunpowder and electromagnetic energy cannons, his Machinery Affinity had a higher bonus after his Promotion, and the power of his cannons had also increased. At the very least, he would not be unable to deal any damage.

Countless bullets bombarded Herlous. − 5, − 6 damage values kept popping up on Herlous' body, mixed with twenty to thirty points of damage from the electromagnetic cannons.

The single damage was not much, but the horrifying attack frequency caused damage values to pop up on Herlous' body like a waterfall. Dozens of times in an instant.

This time, Herlous let out a low roar.

"This tactic … is useless against me!"

—
